docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,000.00 FILED BY KOCHLEF, BILEL AS TO DEFENDANT LEONG, ELAINE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-16-2018 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE: $0.00) SERVED NOV-22-2017, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT LEONG, ELAINE
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE A JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY KOCHLEF, BILEL LEONG, ELAINE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-16-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-16-2018 BY PRO TEM MICHAEL MAU. PLAINTIFF BILEL KOCHLEF IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ELAINE LEONG IS PRESENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE IS DEFECTIVE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. BOTH PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-16-2018 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KOCHLEF, BILEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LEONG, ELAINE $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,075.00, COURT FINDS COMPARATIVE FAULT AT 2/3 TO PLAINTIFF FOR UNSAFE SPEED, AND 1/3 TO DEFENDANT FOR BACKING OUT VEHICLE PARTIALLY ON A STREET WITH AN ADMITTED VEHICLE APPROACHING. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-02-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
